description: Money-impact proposal carries a single provenance entry ('invoice_001') marked untrusted. A signature-evidence entry with a different id ('orphaned_approval') verifies successfully against the embedded keyring, so it enters trust_upgrade_ids. Because the evidence id does not match any provenance id, apply_trust_upgrade_ids_to_provenance leaves 'invoice_001' untrusted; the pipeline then rejects the money-impact proposal at ActionProposal instantiation (step 8) with PIC_VERIFIER_FAILED. The regression invariant pinned here: valid but orphaned evidence MUST NOT upgrade trust on unrelated provenance entries. Corresponds to HERMETICUM Phase 2 case ADV-002, converted to a block-shape vector in v0.9.0a2 to protect the property against a future regression that would apply orphaned trust upgrades to any matching-impact provenance.
